title: Data Request
description: Intent context for `GetAppData`. Requests a single advertised dataset — FDC3 IntentResults are one context, so this type addresses exactly one offer. Targeting is via the Desktop Agent (`raiseIntent` target); this context carries `id.dataId`. `id.dataId` MUST match `id.dataId` from a prior `fdc3.data.appOffer`. The IntentResult type is that offer’s `contextType`.

id.title: Request identifier
id.description: FDC3 context `id` map. `dataId` is required and selects which advertised dataset to return.
